_comment: KPI rows 5-7 (person / intrusion / loitering) eval rules. These rows measure the PRESENCE lane: person detector -> ByteTrack -> full-frame zone monitor -> this rule. The presence detector is deterministic and rides the gate's bypass tier, so the row's number is the detector+tracker's, not a VLM's. Loitering additionally requires the zone monitor's dwell threshold (the harness's presence_dwell_s) before a state is emitted at all.
